item.title: Seed Rule Proposal - Voice Consistency
item.description: Seed Rule Proposal: Knowledge Base Voice Consistency Rule Statement Rule: Define explicit voice and persona standards for the knowledge base — document the intended tone, terminology preferences, and stylistic guidelines that all notes should follow.

item.title: Frontier Exploration - Knowledge Base Persona and Voice Consistency
item.description: Frontier Exploration: Knowledge Base Persona and Voice Consistency The Problem The Seed provides rules for organizing knowledge, verification, and structural patterns — but it doesn’t address how a knowledge base should present itself when interacted with by AI agents or users.

item.description: AI-Assisted Knowledge Management Seed Drop this file into any vault to bootstrap a healthy, self-improving knowledge base.

item.title: AI-Assisted Knowledge Management
item.description: AI-Assisted Knowledge Management How AI enhances each stage of the knowledge management pipeline.

item.title: Anti-Pattern - Link Inflation
item.description: Anti-Pattern: Link Inflation Linking everything to everything dilutes meaning and creates navigational noise.

item.title: Anti-Pattern - Missing Negative Knowledge
item.description: Anti-Pattern: Missing Negative Knowledge Only capturing successes, not failures, creates an incomplete picture.

item.title: Anti-Pattern - Neglecting Maintenance
item.description: Anti-Pattern: Neglecting Maintenance Only adding new notes without reviewing or updating existing ones.

item.title: Anti-Pattern - Note Hoarding
item.description: Anti-Pattern: Note Hoarding Saving everything without processing turns a knowledge base into a graveyard of unvisited notes.

item.title: Anti-Pattern - Over-Organization
item.description: Anti-Pattern: Over-Organization Spending more time organizing than learning wastes energy on the wrong priorities.

item.title: Anti-Pattern - Perfectionism
item.description: Anti-Pattern: Perfectionism Never publishing a note because it’s “not ready” stops all progress.
